title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Department:**
Operations
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-IT Delivery Center Hyderabad
  
  
**Description**
This position is ideal for mid-level quality professionals to join the QARA team as a Quality Assurance Engineer, supporting manufacturing operations and ensuring compliance with quality management requirements. Partnering with manufacturing, cross-functional, and site stakeholders, you’ll drive quality
  
  
assurance activities, process improvements, complaint handling, CAPA management, audits, and regulatory compliance. This role plays a critical part in maintaining product quality, process effectiveness, and adherence to medical device quality standards while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support manufacturing business functions in product quality and environmental compliance across dedicated operational areas.
* Act as a local quality partner for discussions related to PFMEA, non-conformances, CAPAs, product quality, and safety requirements.
* Define quality and validation requirements associated with process changes and collaborate with local teams on implementation.
* Interpret and apply applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and industry regulations.
* Identify, analyze, and lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on process and product quality enhancement.
* Support internal and cross-functional teams in quality improvement and operational excellence activities.
* Ensure quality documentation is established, maintained, effective, and continuously improved.
* Coordinate complaint handling, root cause investigations, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.
* Participate in risk assessments related to processes, products, and design activities.
* Support regulatory, corporate, and external audits and inspections related to the Quality Management System.
* Conduct internal and supplier audits to verify compliance with quality requirements and standards.
* Ensure appropriate quality controls are implemented and maintained throughout manufacturing processes.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for quality processes, providing guidance and coaching to process owners and stakeholders.
* Maintain site document control and change control processes, ensuring compliance with local regulations and internal procedures.
* Review quality documentation, change controls, document archives, translations, and EDMS records for compliance and accuracy.
* Support administration and maintenance of the electronic document management system (EDMS).

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**
Education: Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Engineering, Quality, or a related discipline, postgraduate studies in Quality Management are preferred. Experience: Minimum 3+ years of experience in a quality or compliance role within medical devices or other regulated industries. Strong understanding of Quality System regulations including 21 CFR, ISO 13485, MDR 2017/7

title: Junior Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
CORE Designs is an interior manufacturing unit based in Coimbatore, specializing in the production of customized interior solutions for residential and commercial spaces. The company focuses on quality craftsmanship, efficient production processes, and timely delivery of interior products. Team members collaborate closely across design, production, and finance to support the smooth functioning of operations. Joining CORE Designs offers exposure to a growing manufacturing environment and opportunities to contribute to the financial stability and growth of the business.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Junior Accountant role located at CORE Designs in Coimbatore. The Junior Accountant will assist with day-to-day accounting tasks, including recording financial transactions, maintaining ledgers, and supporting accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Responsibilities include preparing basic financial reports, reconciling bank statements, monitoring petty cash, and helping ensure compliance with company policies and relevant accounting standards. The role will also involve supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, handling documentation for vendors and clients, and coordinating with internal teams and external auditors as needed. The Junior Accountant is expected to work closely with the senior finance team to maintain accurate records and contribute to efficient financial operations within the manufacturing unit.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in basic accounting principles, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, and reconciliation.
* Proficiency in accounting software Tally and good working knowledge of MS Excel and other office tools.
* Ability to manage accounts payable and receivable, prepare simple financial statements, and support budgeting activities.
* Attention to detail, strong numerical ability, and accuracy in data entry and document management.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for interacting with internal teams, vendors, and auditors.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* Prior internship or 0–2 years of experience in an accounting or finance role, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment, is an advantage.
* Salary category- Rs.20000/- to Rs.22000/-

title: SCM Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Tata Motors has been shaping mobility for over eight decades, driven by a strong legacy of innovation and a commitment to excellence. The company integrates next-generation technologies with precise operations and continuous value creation across all vehicles and processes. Its purpose-centered approach focuses on transforming lives, empowering communities, and building next-generation mobility solutions. With an emphasis on smart technology, safer mobility, and greener journeys, Tata Motors is dedicated to creating a cleaner, more connected world. Applicants join an organization committed to sustainability, innovation, and a better future in mobility.
  
**Role Description**
The SCM Engineer role at Tata Motors is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division. The role involves managing software configuration baselines, overseeing build and release processes, and ensuring consistency across development, testing, and production environments. Day-to-day tasks include maintaining version control systems, implementing and monitoring continuous integration pipelines, and coordinating with development teams to resolve configuration and integration issues. The SCM Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to plan releases, track changes, and improve automation, reliability, and traceability of software delivery. The role also includes documenting configuration procedures, enforcing best practices, and supporting audits related to software and configuration management.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Software Configuration Management and Configuration Management, including version control, branching strategies, and baseline management.
* Candidates should possess skills in Release Management, including planning, packaging, deployment coordination, and rollback strategies.
* Candidates should possess skills in Software Development, with experience in scripting or programming languages commonly used in build and automation workflows.
* Candidates should possess skills in Continuous Integration, including setting up and maintaining CI pipelines, build automation, and integration with testing tools.
* Relevant experience with tools such as Git, SVN, CI servers (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI), and issue tracking systems is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with automotive or embedded software environments, and knowledge of DevOps practices, is an advantage.

**Job title** Head – Human Resources

**Company** Dhanraj Global Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DGC)

**Role purpose**

The Head – Human Resources sets up and personally runs every people process for DGC's real estate business, from hiring and payroll to policy, compliance and performance management, in line with DGC's documented HR SOPs.

DGC is a real estate development group with residential, plotted and commercial projects across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This role covers the real estate business only; the group's hospitality operations are outside its scope. It is moving from promoter-driven to professionally managed operations. This role builds the HR backbone that transition needs: documented policies, audit-ready records and consistent processes across head office and project sites.

**What to expect in this role**

This is a hands-on, individual role to begin with, and candidates should apply with that understanding.

· **You are the HR department.** You will start without a team. You will do the work yourself: screening CVs, issuing offer letters, processing payroll inputs, maintaining files and drafting policies.

· **Support comes from other departments, not from reports.** Finance, Legal, site administration and external vendors (recruitment partners, payroll and compliance consultants) will work with you, but none of them report to you.

· **The team comes later, and you will build it.** DGC is open to adding HR team members as headcount and workload grow. You will make the case for those hires and recruit them yourself.

The role suits someone who has run HR single-handedly or in a very small team, and who prefers building a function to inheriting one.

You will carry out each of the following yourself, with operational support from Finance, Legal, site administration and external vendors where noted. All HR work is to be carried out as per DGC's documented HR SOPs, using the prescribed forms and registers.
